item_short_desc: Rothco's Compact 8 x 21MM Binoculars are designed for the outdoor adventurer. Featuring a robust rubberized armored coating, these binoculars offer enhanced grip and protection against the elements. The advanced roof prism system ensures clear, sharp images, while the 8x magnification power allows you to observe distant objects with remarkable clarity. Complete with a convenient carrying case, these compact binoculars are perfect for outdoor enthusiasts, travelers, and sports fans.
